# ChrisCraft Interactive

> ChrisCraft Interactive is a small independent game studio that makes fun, easy-to-play mobile games. Its first game is ScaleUp: Cosmic Growth for Android.

- Website: https://chriscraftinteractive.com/
- Contact: support@chriscraftinteractive.com
- Instagram (ScaleUp official): @scaleup.cg – https://www.instagram.com/scaleup.cg/

## Games

- [ScaleUp: Cosmic Growth](https://chriscraftinteractive.com/scaleup): free arcade game for Android, coming soon to Google Play. Start as a tiny speck and grow into the whole universe.

## ScaleUp: Cosmic Growth – key facts

- Genre: arcade / casual growth game ("grow by absorbing smaller things")
- Platform: Android (Google Play), free to play with ads and optional Fusion Orbs purchases
- 113 levels, from quarks and atoms out to the cosmic web
- One real science fact per level
- 6 game modes, including Team Battle
- 22 vehicles, each with its own power, upgradable in the garage
- 17 ranks across 8 leagues
- Reward wheel that multiplies rewards up to ×4
- Developer: ChrisCraft Interactive
- Status: coming soon to Google Play
- Official Instagram (news, trailers, launch updates): @scaleup.cg – https://www.instagram.com/scaleup.cg/

## Pages

- [ScaleUp level map – all 113 levels](https://chriscraftinteractive.com/scaleup-levels): every object from a Planck speck (1.6 × 10⁻³⁵ m) to the observable universe (8.8 × 10²⁶ m), with its size and a science fact.
